mn28:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn28:1.3: tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn28:1.5: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
mn28:2.1: seyyathāpi āvuso yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti, hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati yadidaṃ mahantattena;
mn28:2.2: evameva kho āvuso ye keci kusalā dhammā sabbe te catūsu ariyasaccesu saṅgahaṃ gacchanti.
mn28:2.4: dukkhe ariyasacce, dukkhasamudaye ariyasacce, dukkhanirodhe ariyasacce, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasacce.
mn28:3.2: jātipi dukkhā, jarāpi dukkhā, maraṇampi dukkhaṃ, sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsāpi dukkhā, yampicchaṃ na labhati tampi dukkhaṃ, saṅkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā dukkhā.
mn28:3.4: seyyathidaṃ rūpūpādānakkhandho vedanūpādānakkhandho saññūpādānakkhandho saṅkhārūpādānakkhandho, viññāṇūpādānakkhandho.
mn28:4.2: cattāri ca mahābhūtāni catunnañca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ.
mn28:6.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyathidaṃ:
mn28:6.5: kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ,
mn28:6.7: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā paṭhavīdhātu, yā ca bāhirā paṭhavīdhātu, paṭhavīdhāturevesā.
mn28:6.8: ‘taṃ netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn28:6.9: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā paṭhavīdhātuyā nibbindati. paṭhavīdhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn28:7.1: hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ bāhirā āpodhātu pakuppati.
mn28:7.2: antarahitā tasmiṃ samaye bāhirā paṭhavīdhātu hoti.
mn28:7.3: tassā hi nāma āvuso bāhirāya paṭhavīdhātuyā tāva mahallikāya aniccatā paññāyissati, khayadhammatā paññāyissati, vayadhammatā paññāyissati, vipariṇāmadhammatā paññāyissati.
mn28:7.4: kimpanimassa mattaṭṭhakassa kāyassa taṇhūpādinnassa ‘ahanti vā, mamanti vā, asmītivā’. atha khvassa no cevettha hoti.
mn28:8.1: tañce āvuso bhikkhuṃ pare akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti vihesenti, so evaṃ pajānāti:
mn28:8.2: uppannā kho me ayaṃ sotasamphassajā dukkhā vedanā.
mn28:8.3: sā ca kho paṭicca no appaṭicca.
mn28:8.6: so phasso aniccoti passati. vedanā aniccāti passati. saññā aniccāti passati. saṅkhārā aniccāti passati. viññāṇaṃ aniccanti passati.
mn28:8.7: tassa dhātārammaṇameva cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
mn28:9.1: tañce āvuso bhikkhuṃ pare aniṭṭhehi akantehi amanāpehi samudācaranti:
mn28:9.4: “tathābhūto kho ayaṃ kāyo yathābhūtasmiṃ kāye pāṇisamphassāpi kamanti, leḍḍusamphassāpi kamanti, daṇḍasamphassāpi kamanti, satthasamphassāpi kamanti.
mn28:9.6: ‘ubhato daṇḍakena cepi bhikkhave kakacena corā ocarakā aṅgamaṅgāni okanteyyuṃ, tatrāpi yo mano padoseyya na me so tena sāsanakaro’ti.
mn28:9.7: āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ bhavissati asallīnaṃ. upaṭṭhitā sati apammuṭṭhā. passaddho kāyo asāraddho. samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ.
mn28:9.8: kāmaṃdāni imasmiṃ kāye pāṇisamphassāpi kamantu, leḍḍusamphassāpi kamantu, daṇḍasamphassāpi kamantu, satthasamphassāpi kamantu, karīyati hidaṃ buddhānaṃ sāsana”nti.
mn28:10.1: tassa ce āvuso bhikkhuno evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā na saṇṭhāti.
mn28:10.3: ‘alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā, dulladdhaṃ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṃ,
mn28:10.4: yassa me evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā na saṇṭhātī’ti.
mn28:10.5: seyyathāpi āvuso suṇisā sasuraṃ disvā saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati.
mn28:10.6: evameva kho āvuso tassa ce bhikkhuno evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā na saṇṭhāti, so tena saṃvijjati, saṃvegaṃ āpajjati:
mn28:10.7: ‘alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā, dulladdhaṃ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṃ, yassa me evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā na saṇṭhātī’ti.
mn28:10.8: tassa ce āvuso bhikkhuno evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā saṇṭhāti, so tena attamano hoti.
mn28:10.9: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hoti.
mn28:11.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādinnaṃ: seyyathidaṃ –
mn28:11.5: pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā kheḷo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttaṃ, yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ āpo āpogataṃ upādinnaṃ –
mn28:11.7: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā āpodhātu yā ca bāhirā āpodhātu āpodhāturevesā.
mn28:11.8: taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn28:11.9: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā āpodhātuyā nibbindati, āpodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn28:12.1: hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ bāhirā āpodhātu pakuppati.
mn28:12.2: sā gāmampi vahati, nigamampi vahati, nagarampi vahati, janapadampi vahati, janapadapadesampi vahati.
mn28:12.3: hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ mahāsamudde yojanasatikānipi udakāni ogacchanti, dviyojanasatikānipi udakāni ogacchanti, tiyojanasatikānipi udakāni ogacchanti, catuyojanasatikānipi udakāni ogacchanti, pañcayojanasatikānipi udakāni ogacchanti, chayojanasatikānipi udakāni ogacchanti, sattayojanasatikānipi udakāni ogacchanti. –
mn28:12.4: hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ mahāsamudde sattatālampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, chatālampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, pañcatālampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, catutālampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, titālampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, dvitālampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, tālampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti.
mn28:12.5: hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ mahāsamudde sattaporisampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, chaporisampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, pañcaporisampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, catuporisampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, tiporisampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, dviporisampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, porisampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti.
mn28:12.6: hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ mahāsamudde addhaporisampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, kaṭimattampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, jaṇṇumattampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, gopphakamattampi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti.
mn28:12.7: hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ mahāsamudde aṅgulipabbatemanamattampi udakaṃ na hoti.
mn28:12.8: tassā hi nāma āvuso bāhirāya āpodhātuyā tāva mahallikāya aniccatā paññāyissati
mn28:14.1: tassa ce āvuso bhikkhuno [evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato, evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato] evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā saṇṭhāti, so tena attamano hoti.
mn28:15.1: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hoti.
mn28:16.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ - seyyathidaṃ:
mn28:16.5: yena ca santappati, yena ca jarīyati, yena ca pariḍayhati, yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ –
mn28:16.7: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā tejodhātu yā ca bāhirā tejodhātu tejodhāturevesā.
mn28:16.8: taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn28:16.9: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā tejodhātuyā nibbindati. tejodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn28:17.1: hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ bāhirā tejodhātu pakuppati.
mn28:17.2: sā gāmampi ḍahati, nigamampi ḍahati, nagarampi ḍahati, janapadampi ḍahati, janapadapadesampi ḍahati.
mn28:17.3: sā haritantaṃ vā panthantaṃ vā selantaṃ vā udakantaṃ vā ramaṇīyaṃ vā bhūmibhāgaṃ āgamma anāhārā nibbāyati.
mn28:17.4: hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ kukkuṭapattenapi nahārudaddulenapi aggiṃ gavesanti.
mn28:17.5: tassā hi nāma āvuso bāhirāya tejodhātuyā tāva mahallikāya aniccatā paññāyissati
mn28:18-20.1: …pe… tassa ce āvuso bhikkhuno evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā saṇṭhāti, so tena attamano hoti.
mn28:18-20.2: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hoti.
mn28:21.4: yaṃ ajjhattaṃ, paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ - seyyathidaṃ:
mn28:21.5: uddhaṅgamā vātā, adhogamā vātā, kucchisayā vātā, koṭṭhasayā vātā, aṅgamaṅgānusārino vātā, assāso passāso iti vā, yaṃ vā panaññampi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ vāyo vāyogataṃ upādinnaṃ –
mn28:21.7: yā ceva kho pana ajjhattikā vāyodhātu yā ca bāhirā vāyodhātu vāyodhāturevesā.
mn28:21.8: taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn28:21.9: evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā vāyodhātuyā nibbindati, vāyodhātuyā cittaṃ virājeti.
mn28:22.1: hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ bāhirā vāyodhātu pakuppati,
mn28:22.2: sā gāmampi vahati, nigamampi vahati, nagarampi vahati, janapadampi vahati, janapadapadesampi vahati.
mn28:22.3: hoti kho so āvuso samayo yaṃ gimhānaṃ pacchime māse tālavaṇṭenapi vidhūpanenapi vātaṃ pariyesanti, ossāvanepi tiṇāni na iñjanti.
mn28:22.4: tassā hi nāma āvuso bāhirāya vāyodhātuyā tāva mahallikāya aniccatā paññāyissati, khayadhammatā paññāyissati, vayadhammatā paññāyissati, vipariṇāmadhammatā paññāyissati.
mn28:22.5: kimpanimassa mattaṭṭhakassa kāyassa taṇhupādinnassa ‘ahanti vā mamanti vā asmīti vā,’ atha khvassa no cevettha hoti.
mn28:23.1: tañce āvuso bhikkhuṃ pare akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti vihesenti,

mn28:23.7: tassa dhātārammaṇameva cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.

mn28:25.8: ‘alābhā vata me na vata me lābhā, dulladdhaṃ vata me na vata me suladdhaṃ,
mn28:25.9: yassa me evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā na saṇṭhātī’ti.
mn28:25.10: tassa ce āvuso bhikkhuno evaṃ buddhaṃ anussarato evaṃ dhammaṃ anussarato evaṃ saṅghaṃ anussarato upekkhā kusalanissitā saṇṭhāti, so tena attamano hoti.
mn28:25.11: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hoti.
mn28:26.1: seyyathāpi āvuso kaṭṭhañca paṭicca valliñca paṭicca tiṇañca paṭicca mattikañca paṭicca ākāso parivārito agāranteva saṅkhaṃ gacchati,
mn28:26.2: evameva kho āvuso aṭṭhiñca paṭicca nahāruñca paṭicca maṃsañca paṭicca cammañca paṭicca ākāso parivārito rūpanteva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. –
mn28:27.1: ajjhattikañce āvuso cakkhuṃ aparibhinnaṃ hoti, bāhirā ca rūpā na āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, no ca tajjo samannāhāro hoti, neva tāva tajjassa viññāṇabhāgassa pātubhāvo hoti.
mn28:27.2: ajjhattikañce āvuso cakkhuṃ aparibhinnaṃ hoti, bāhirā ca rūpā āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, no ca tajjo samannāhāro hoti, nevatāva tajjassa viññāṇabhāgassa pātubhāvo hoti.
mn28:27.3: yato ca kho āvuso ajjhattikañce cakkhuṃ aparibhinnaṃ hoti. bāhirā ca rūpā āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, tajjo ca samannāhāro hoti, evaṃ tajjassa viññāṇabhāgassa pātubhāvo hoti.
mn28:28.1: yaṃ tathābhūtassa rūpaṃ, taṃ rūpūpādānakkhandhe saṅgahaṃ gacchati. yā tathābhūtassa vedanā, sā vedanūpādānakkhandhe saṅgahaṃ gacchati. yā tathābhūtassa saññā, sā saññūpādānakkhandhe saṅgahaṃ gacchati. ye tathābhūtassa saṅkhārā, te saṅkhārūpādānakkhandhe saṅgahaṃ gacchanti. yaṃ tathābhūtassa viññāṇaṃ, taṃ viññāṇūpādānakkhandhe saṅgahaṃ gacchati.
mn28:28.3: “evaṃ kiramesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ saṅgaho sannipāto samavāyo hoti.
mn28:28.6: yo dhammaṃ passati. so paṭiccasamuppādaṃ passatī’ti.
mn28:28.8: yo imesu pañcasupādānakkhandhesu chando ālayo anunayo ajjhosānaṃ, so dukkhasamudayo.
mn28:28.9: yo imesu pañcasupādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, so dukkhanirodho”ti.
mn28:28.10: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hoti.

mn28:33-34.1: jivhā aparibhinnā hoti. [bāhirā ca rasā na āpāthaṃ āgacchanti] …pe… [ajjhattiko ce āvuso]
mn28:35-36.1: kāyo aparibhinno hoti. [bāhirā ca phoṭṭhabbā na āpāthaṃ āgacchanti] …pe… [ajjhattiko ce āvuso]

mn28:38.5: “evaṃ kiramesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ saṅgaho sannipāto samavāyo hoti.
mn28:38.8: yo dhammaṃ passati so paṭiccasamuppādaṃ passatī’ti.
mn28:38.10: yo imesu pañcasupādānakkhandhesu chando ālayo anunayo ajjhosānaṃ so dukkhasamudayo,
mn28:38.11: yo imesu pañcasupādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ so dukkhanirodho”ti.
mn28:38.12: ettāvatāpi kho āvuso bhikkhuno bahukataṃ hotīti.
mn28:38.14: attamanā te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
